text:
A man stands 110m from a high wall. He makes a short, sharp sound and then hears an echo
from the wall.
The speed of sound in air is 330m/s.
How long after making the sound does the man hear the echo?
A
0.33s
B
0.67s
C
1.5s
D
3.0s
subject: Physics
